TLDR.value: A novel method for unsupervised learning, based on novel theories of the brain

abstract.value: Unsupervised learning methods have a soft inspiration in cognition models. To this day, the most successful unsupervised learning methods revolve around clustering samples in a mathematical space. In this paper we propose a primitive-based unsupervised learning approach inspired by novel cognition models. This representation-centric approach models the input space constructively as a distributed hierarchical structure in an input-agnostic way. We compared our approach with the current state-of-the-art in unsupervised learning: K-Means for tabular data and IIC for image data. We show how our proposal performs better in average than any of the alternatives. We also evaluate some cognition-like properties of our proposal that other algorithms lack, even supervised learning ones.

primary_area.value: unsupervised, self-supervised, semi-supervised, and supervised representation learning
